candidates.description: This feature vector represents the Thai consonant 'ก' (ko kai) and words or letter combinations containing it, alongside unrelated English terms like 'opioid'.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant 'ส' (so suea) across various syllable blocks, vowel combinations, and words.
This feature vector represents the Thai vowel sign 'โ' (O-vowel) in various character combinations and contexts.
This feature vector is related to Thai script tokens and common Thai syllable fragments containing the character 'เป' (pe).
This feature vector activates on non-English script fragments, Latin letters, and prefixes common in foreign or scientific terminology.
This feature vector represents common Thai conjunctions, prepositions, and grammatical particles used to connect words and phrases.
This vector represents common Thai character combinations and linguistic suffixes alongside noisy ASCII fragments.
This feature vector activates on tokens related to opiates, alkaloids, and various non-English scripts, particularly Thai characters and diacritics.
This feature vector represents linguistic subwords, fragments, and affixes shared across multiple languages, including English, Thai, and Latin-derived terms.
This feature activates on a random, highly heterogeneous mix of subword fragments, punctuation marks, and multi-lingual characters with no unifying semantic theme.
